name: svg-editor-cli
description: Lab1 Phase 2：插件式 SVG CLI、VSCode 文件标记与大纲、DSH 会话工具

scripts.setup:extensions: npm --prefix extensions/vscode-svg ci && npm --prefix extensions/dsh-svg ci
scripts.check:all: npm run check && npm --prefix extensions/vscode-svg run check && npm --prefix extensions/dsh-svg run check
scripts.test:all: npm test && npm --prefix extensions/vscode-svg test && npm --prefix extensions/dsh-svg test
scripts.package:extensions: npm --prefix extensions/vscode-svg run package && npm --prefix extensions/dsh-svg run package
scripts.metrics:complete: node scripts/metrics.mjs final p2-complete docs/metrics/complete p2-complete && node scripts/metrics-extensions.mjs p2-complete docs/metrics/extensions p2-complete
